name: Azad Engineering Limited
summary: Azad Engineering Limited, established in Hyderabad in 1983, makes and distributes high-precision engineered parts produced by forging and machining. Products include body valves, compressor housings, fan blisks, turbine wheels, nozzles, airfoils and blades, missile components for defense, and parts for hydraulic, flight control and actuating systems. It also makes rotors, stators and combustion components.
